jobs.description: About Us At algo1, we are reinventing one of the world’s most familiar experiences: the in-store grocery trip. We are building an AI-native product that understands each shopper, responds to their context in real time and makes an everyday experience less stressful, more personal and more engaging. We’re backed by leading investors and founded by two entrepreneurs: one with a track record of building companies, and the other a recognised leader in data and shopper analytics. Together, they have built a team of frontier AI researchers and engineers, product and strategy leaders, and senior operators from major UK and US grocery businesses. The people who join now will have an opportunity to shape the product, the culture, and what algo1 becomes. The Role You'll report to our Head of Design, who sets the overall design direction across our consumer and business applications, brand and website. You'll be our most senior hands-on product designer, owning the UX, UI and design system of our consumer applications, with significant influence over product direction. We're building something with no established design playbook: a consumer experience that connects the digital and physical worlds of grocery shopping. The challenge is that a store isn't a website. Shoppers are moving, browsing shelves and making decisions in seconds. The store must remain the main event, with our technology playing a supporting role rather than competing for attention. The hardest part is making this feel intuitive for everyone, from digitally confident shoppers to people who rarely use technology in stores. You'll need exceptional consumer mobile design skills, the curiosity to rethink familiar interaction patterns and the judgement to make sophisticated AI feel effortless. You'll work closely with product, engineering and machine learning to shape what we build, not just how it looks. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
jobs.description: Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on. The Role As Senior Product Designer you shape how our customers and operators experience Optics11’s end-to-end underwater security solutions: from in-field sensor data acquisition, through data processing, to the software platform where that data is exposed and acted on. You combine user research with hands-on UX/UI design: you understand users in the field, turn those insights into workflows and interface designs, and hand over clear, build-ready designs to our front-end developers. You are part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with Product Management, R&D, Engineering, Data Science, Software, Sales, Projects and Application Engineering. No two weeks will look the same. You might join an Application Engineer in the field, interview operators and technicians, trace how sensor data flows from the field to the operator’s screen, prototype a new workflow in Figma, or review a front-end implementation with the developers. You own the user experience of our software platform, from research insight to interface design, and make sure real user needs guide decisions across technical, product and commercial teams. Within your first 6–12 months, you will establish a shared, evidence-based view of our users through personas, journey maps and a structured insight repository; evolve our design system and UI guidelines for the software platform; and deliver interface designs for priority platform features that our developers can build with confidence. jobs.description: About us At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. The role Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients. You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it.
